name: QuickBooks Online
description: QuickBooks customers, invoices and any query: look up, create invoices, run reports-style queries.
help: Two ways in. FASTEST: paste the Client ID + secret below, press Connect and approve in the browser. ALTERNATIVE: run Intuit's OAuth playground once and paste the Refresh Token. Either way also paste your Company ID (realm id, digits in your QuickBooks URL). Tokens refresh themselves; rotated ones are saved back. Set sandbox to yes while testing.

fields.label: Refresh token (filled by Connect, or paste from the playground)
